elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an affiliate
elements.evidence: "The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate"

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: "or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets"

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent
elements.evidence: "HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company"

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment not to be unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "(such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed)"

elements.element: Vendor never to assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: "and in no event to a competitor of the Company"

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: "no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate"

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors with written notice
elements.evidence: No notice mechanic appears; Customer assignment is "without HDI's consent" and Vendor assignment requires consent, not notice

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: "such consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed"

reasons: All atomic elements of the locked preferred level are met: Customer free assignment to affiliates and merger/acquisition/asset-sale successors, Vendor assignment gated by Customer consent (not unreasonably withheld), an absolute competitor bar, and no Vendor termination right on Customer change of control.

The fallback is not satisfied on its own terms (no written-notice mechanic and no mutual successor-assignment right), but that is irrelevant because the preferred level is complete; the two levels are not combined.

Because the original was only a successors-and-assigns sentence, a concise insertion was necessary; however the edit adds protections beyond the preferred position "re-price or suspend" and an extra permitted trigger "reorganization", plus "or delayed", so it is broader than needed.
The replacement re-states the original sentence verbatim, so the untouched commercial terms remain effective and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
Tighten by dropping "re-price or suspend", "reorganization" and "or delayed", and anchor the insertion after the existing sentence rather than restating it, to clear the minimality gate.
